120c7608f0e04afc60f7.en: Ordinal numbers tell us the place in a line.
120c7608f0e04afc60f7.id: Bilangan urutan (ordinal) menunjukkan tempat dalam satu barisan.

12d88721ee349702c144.en: Counting from the left, the cat is 1st and the dog is 2nd.
12d88721ee349702c144.id: Kalau dihitung dari kiri, kucing ada di urutan 1st dan anjing di urutan 2nd.

bcb3d1b5f3e07a241b1c.en: We also say first, second, third and fourth.
bcb3d1b5f3e07a241b1c.id: Kita juga menyebutnya first, second, third, dan fourth.

15946473ba946fbce64e.en: After 4th, most places end in th.

a633e833ef31aae8a9ec.en: Counting from the left: 1st frog, 2nd cow, 3rd owl.
a633e833ef31aae8a9ec.id: Dihitung dari kiri: 1st katak (frog), 2nd sapi (cow), 3rd burung hantu (owl).

6cad61637b84e7e704fe.en: The place after 4th is 5th, so Maya is 5th.
6cad61637b84e7e704fe.id: Urutan setelah 4th adalah 5th, jadi Maya di urutan 5th.

3f820eda39bf0a51631b.en: 1st means first place. 2nd means second place.
3f820eda39bf0a51631b.id: 1st berarti urutan pertama (first). 2nd berarti urutan kedua (second).

913fd788e5e6de203863.en: 3rd is read as third. Second is written 2nd.

e53ca0524cdbff1893e4.en: There are only 10 places, so the 10th is the last one.
e53ca0524cdbff1893e4.id: Hanya ada 10 urutan, jadi urutan 10th adalah yang terakhir.
